caption: A rower pulls an oar from the water, the blade dripping water back into the lake. .
old_relations: Oar blade contacts water, creating drag force pulling rower’s arm upward.
Water adheres to blade via surface tension, dripping as blade lifts clear of water.
Blade’s angle and motion determine water’s trajectory back into lake.
Water’s mass and gravity ensure continuous drip until blade fully clears surface.

proposed.semantic_focus: A rower lifts an oar from the water, causing droplets to detach and fall back into the lake surface.
relations: Upward motion of the blade separates it from the water surface.
Gravity pulls residual water off the blade as it rises.
Falling droplets impact the lake, creating small ripples.
